answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it repeats an already-claimed task or fails a randomly audited commitment. Auditors are selected from bonded agents, and rewards depend on verified work rather than account count, so one operator cannot profit simply by spawning identities. Like a tide crossing a meadow, repeated identities leave the same operational traces; the fable of effortless scale breaks down when every new account needs fresh capital and risks losing it.
